cash_movements_disclaimer: Cash movements only. Not trading performance.
currency_balance_disclaimer: Currencies are shown separately. Practice balances are excluded.
sidebar_workspace_description: Balances and funding are for account servicing. No dealing or order tools.
requested_account_not_found: The requested account could not be found.
account_details_description: Balances, margin and workspace movements for account servicing. Dealing and order tools stay on the trading platform.
equity_composition_description: Equity is your balance plus unrealised profit or loss on open positions; margin in use is equity less free margin, exactly as the platform reports them. These figures mirror the trading platform for account servicing and are not a live risk view.
bank_transfer_recorded: Bank transfer recorded by the cashier
card_deposit_recorded: Card deposit recorded by the cashier
no_eligible_transfer_accounts: No eligible same-currency transfer accounts are available.
internal_transfer_description: Internal transfers move settled funds between your own live accounts in the same currency. They are not a dealing or currency-conversion tool.
platform_password_description: Changes the MT5 main (trading) password for this account. The investor password is unchanged, and the portal never stores or redisplays what you set.
account_details_disclaimer: Figures mirror the trading platform for account servicing and are not a live risk view.
accounts_page_description: Balances, funding and onboarding stay in this CRM view. No dealing or order tools.
unrealised_pl_disclaimer: Unrealised P/L is shown per account. Currencies are never added together.
broker_policy_revision: Published by your broker · policy revision 3. Platform routing details remain broker-only.
accounts_disclaimer: Figures mirror the trading platform for account servicing and are not a live risk view. The portal holds no exchange rates, so balances in different currencies are never added together.
dashboard_intro_description: Your accounts, activity and next steps. All in one place.
fund_page_description: Choose a payment method, see every fee upfront and review the final amount before you submit.
scores_within_tolerance: Scores within 15 bps of the settled close.
choose_direction_description: Choose a direction before the prediction window closes.
gold_direction_question: What is the next directional move for gold?
time_boxed_prediction_description: Make one time-boxed prediction. Trading activity is never required.
strongest_market_impact_question: Which event has the strongest scheduled market impact?
broker_calendar_description: Use the broker education calendar and select one event.
closest_forecast_description: Closest eligible forecast within the broker tolerance scores.
one_entry_cannot_change: One entry per match — your pick cannot be changed once locked.
split_hidden_until_locked: The split stays hidden until your prediction is locked, so the room cannot lead your answer.
leaderboard_privacy_note: Rankings carry usernames only — never account numbers, balances or trading activity.
select_match_instruction: Select a match to bring it into the arena above.
games_educational_disclaimer: Predictions are educational and test your market judgement. They never place orders or change account controls, and financial activity is never an input, a stake or a tie-break.
games_page_description: Broker-branded educational games and pseudonymous leaderboards. Financial activity is never an input.
username_privacy_note: Broker-reserved words are blocked. Rankings show this name only — never your account or contact details.
onboarding_completion_description: Every onboarding step is complete. Funding and account opening are available to you.
onboarding_nothing_further_needed: Nothing further is needed from you.
confirm_contact_details: Confirm contact details and preferred language.
submit_kyc_documents: Submit broker-managed KYC documents for review.
identity_verification_complete_note: Identity verification is complete. Your broker will contact you if any further review is needed.
fund_live_account: Fund a live account through the cashier.
select_account_type: Select an account type from the broker catalogue.
onboarding_broker_review_note: Steps are marked complete by your broker's review, not by this portal.
open_account_description: Traders see display name, currency and environment only. MT5 groups stay broker-side.
profile_page_description: Identity, security and contact preferences. Sensitive details stay masked in this CRM view.
profile_contact_details_note: Contact details are held by your broker. Changes go through
profile_session_description: A session is one signed-in browser or device. If a count looks wrong,
profile_support_can_end_sessions: they can end sessions for you.
product_updates_description: Changes to the portal and your account tools
marketing_email_description: Offers and programme news from your broker
profile_service_messages_note: Service messages about your money — funding, statements, security — are always sent and cannot be turned off.
referrals_page_description: Invite friends with your broker referral code. Whether an invite counts as funded follows your broker's attribution rules.
referral_activity_privacy_note: Invitee addresses are masked here and are never shown in full — you invited them, but their account is theirs.
referral_invite_message: Join me on HX Nexus! Register using my referral link: {{link}}
rewards_page_description: Finish broker-managed challenges, then redeem from the catalogue. Games live on their own page.
reward_requests_disabled_note: These records show the experience; reward requests remain disabled.
secure_account_description: Complete the broker security enrolment checklist.
learning_week_description: Finish two broker education modules this week.
ten_lot_week_description: Trade 10 eligible executed lots during this challenge window.
know_workspace_description: Complete the broker platform orientation before it begins.
broker_learning_session_description: A one-to-one education session with the broker team.
education_resource_pack_description: A broker-curated collection of learning materials.
platform_vps_credit_description: Three months of broker-hosted VPS for your MetaTrader terminal.
reward_requests_api_note: Reward requests open once your broker's Client API is connected.
finish_challenge_to_reach: Finish an open challenge to reach ◆ {{count}}.
rewards_ledger_note: Points are issued and reversed by your broker. This portal displays the record; it never edits it.
statements_page_description: Monthly digests of activity, funding and fees, issued after each month closes.
monthly_statement_description: Monthly activity, funding and fee summary for your {{currency}} account.
select_issued_statement: Select an issued statement from the archive.
statement_scope_description: A statement summarises activity, funding and fees for one calendar month on one account currency.
broker_record_description: Every figure is a broker record. The portal displays them and never recomputes them.
broker_branding_description: The PDF carries your broker's brand pack and legal name, not this portal's.
month_end_settlement_description: A period becomes available once month-end settlement completes, which is why the current month reads as pending.
support_page_description: Live chat when agents are online, tickets when they are not, plus broker notices.
search_tickets_aria: Search tickets by subject, category, status or reference
try_another_ticket_search: Try another subject, category or reference.
clear_search_or_try_different_term: Clear the search or try a different search term.
ticket_form_help: Describe your question. Support replies appear in your ticket list.
agents_online_start_chat: Agents are online. Start a chat to contact support.
describe_help_needed: Describe what you need help with
chat_welcome: Hello! Welcome to HX Nexus support. How can we help you today?
never_send_passwords_or_card_numbers: Never send passwords or card numbers
support_security_notice: Support will never ask for them. Transcripts are retained by your broker.
ticket_withdrawal_question: When should my bank-transfer withdrawal complete?
ticket_withdrawal_reply: The payment desk is reviewing it. We will update this ticket as soon as the bank reference is available.
ticket_mt5_question: Where can I find the server details for MT5 mobile?
ticket_mt5_reply: Open the account details page and use the platform credentials section. The server itself remains broker-managed.
support_hours_description: Client support is available 07:00–19:00 UTC on weekdays. Payment review may take longer during settlement windows.
document_refresh_description: If your address proof is older than 90 days, upload a fresh copy from Verification before requesting higher limits.
transfer_page_description: Move settled funds between your own same-currency accounts with a full before-and-after balance preview.
move_settled_funds_with_preview: Move settled funds with a clear preview
transfer_banner_description: Choose two compatible accounts, review both resulting balances, then confirm once.
same_currency_required: Both accounts must have the same currency.
demonstration_transfer_note: Demonstration transfer — balances update locally after confirmation.
internal_transfer_security_note: Internal transfers are limited to eligible same-currency accounts.
